{{Ophiuchus}}

Ophiuchus is the 13th month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 49–52.

== Overview ==
===Etymology===
English ''Ophiuchus'' "the Serpent-Bearer" (Greek ''ophis'' serpent + ''ekhein'' to hold). Japanese: {{ill|蛇遣座|ja|Hebitsukai-za}} “snake-handler constellation.”  
'''Note:''' In popular astrology Ophiuchus is sometimes called a "13th sign." In the Gaian system it is a full month (Days [[Ophiuchus 1]]–[[Ophiuchus 28]]) preceding the intercalary **Horus** month.
